title: Content Entry Resolution Request
description: Request to resolve a content entry by canonical key and contextual dimensions (market, locale, digital estate). Supports temporal resolution and preview mode for draft content per ADR-0014 inheritance policy.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier (required; all content is tenant-scoped)

legal_entity_id.description: Legal entity context (optional; narrows resolution scope)

digital_estate_id.description: Digital estate context (optional; narrows resolution scope)

market_id.description: Market context (optional; narrows resolution scope per ADR-0014 §7)

locale.description: Locale (optional, BCP 47 format; e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr-CA'). Resolution follows explicit locale fallback chain per ADR-0014 §27.

effective_time.description: Effective timestamp for temporal resolution (optional; defaults to current time). Used to resolve entries with effectiveFrom/effectiveTo boundaries.

preview_mode.description: Allow draft/preview content (optional; defaults to false). When true, includes DRAFT publication state in eligibility.
